title: Wave VIII — Process Execution Safety
scope: Shell command execution: sandboxing, resource bounds, output verification
topics: Command execution bounded (time, memory, output size)
Environment isolation (no access to sensitive env vars)
Return code handling (non-zero means failure, properly checked)
Stderr capture invariant (errors are always recorded)
proof_principle: Every proof proves what is already declared in the model. No new types, predicates, or invariants.
